issue_context.title: planner: sink into or push down Limit through Intersection IndexMerge
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
```
CREATE TABLE `t2` (
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `c` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  KEY `a` (`a`),
  KEY `b` (`b`)
);

mysql> explain select /*+ use_index_merge(t2, a, b) */ * from t2 where a=1 and b=1 limit 1;
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| id                               | estRows | task      | access object        | operator info                               |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Limit_10                         | 0.01    | root      |                      | offset:0, count:1                           |
| └─IndexMerge_14                  | 0.01    | root      |                      | type: intersection                          |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_11(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:a(a) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_12(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:b(b) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|   └─TableRowIDScan_13(Probe)     | 0.01    | cop[tikv] | table:t2             | keep order:false, stats:pseudo              |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
5 rows in set (0.00 sec)


mysql> explain select /*+ use_index_merge(t2, a, b) */ * from t2 where a=1 and b=1 and c=1 limit 1;
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| id                               | estRows | task      | access object        | operator info                               |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Limit_10                         | 0.00    | root      |                      | offset:0, count:1                           |
| └─IndexMerge_15                  | 0.01    | root      |                      | type: intersection                          |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_11(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:a(a) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_12(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:b(b) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|   └─Selection_14(Probe)          | 0.01    | cop[tikv] |                      | eq(test.t2.c, 1)                            |
|     └─TableRowIDScan_13          | 0.01    | cop[tikv] | table:t2             | keep order:false, stats:pseudo              |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+

```

The Limit should be sunk into the intersection IndexMerge to help avoid reading unnecessary data from the table, so a better plan should be like:
```
mysql> explain select /*+ use_index_merge(t2, a, b) */ * from t2 where a=1 and b=1 limit 1;
+--------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| id                             | estRows | task      | access object        | operator info                                         |
+--------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| IndexMerge_14                  | 0.01    | root      |                      | type: intersection, limit embedded(offset:0, count:1) |
| ├─IndexRangeScan_11(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:a(a) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo           |
| ├─IndexRangeScan_12(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:b(b) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo           |
| └─TableRowIDScan_13(Probe)     | 0.01    | cop[tikv] | table:t2             | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                        |
+--------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)




mysql> explain select /*+ use_index_merge(t2, a, b) */ * from t2 where a=1 and b=1 and c=1 limit 1;
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| id                               | estRows | task      | access object        | operator info                               |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| Limit_10                         | 0.00    | root      |                      | offset:0, count:1                           |
| └─IndexMerge_15                  | 0.01    | root      |                      | type: intersection                          |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_11(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:a(a) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_12(Build)     | 10.00   | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:b(b) | range:[1,1], keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
|    +---Limit_10                         | 0.00    | root      |                      | offset:0, count:1                           |
|          └─Selection_14(Probe)          | 0.01    | cop[tikv] |                      | eq(test.t2.c, 1)                            |
|               └─TableRowIDScan_13          | 0.01    | cop[tikv] | table:t2             | keep order:false, stats:pseudo              |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------+

```
comments: This first case can be solved by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/46308.

review_comments: Another precondition is that there is no table filter? Specifically, no `Selection` on the `TableScan` in the plan.
